description: Workflow State and Schema Baseline - Define and freeze typed workflow state contracts with migration-safe versioning.
changeLog: 2026-02-24: US-001 completed - introduced typed WorkflowStateSnapshot contract (stage/status/metadata/artifacts), centralized state snapshot construction, and added invariant tests for persisted state schema fields.

userStories.title: Define canonical workflow state schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a canonical workflow state schema so that all stages share one deterministic contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Define typed core workflow state schema for stage, status, metadata, and artifact references
Publish schema in code artifacts as the single source of truth for persisted workflow state
Typecheck passes
userStories.learnings: Added WorkflowStateSnapshot typed contract in src/workflow/workflow_engine.py with explicit phase normalization, metadata/artifacts sections, and schema version constant; persisted state now builds from single snapshot constructor and tests assert schema + metadata/artifacts invariants.

userStories.title: Add schema version field and freeze policy
userStories.description: As a developer, I want explicit schema versioning so that state evolution is controlled and backward-safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Add explicit schema version field to persisted workflow state
Define frozen schema policy for non-breaking changes and version increments
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define state migration contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a migration contract so that older persisted states can be safely upgraded.
acceptanceCriteria: Define migration entrypoint from prior schema versions to current version
Specify deterministic migration order and required invariants after migration
Typecheck passes
researchTopics: Existing migration patterns for workflow state in this codebase
Best practices for versioned JSON state migration with deterministic transforms

userStories.title: Implement load-time schema validation boundary
userStories.description: As a developer, I want workflow state validated at load time so that invalid persisted data is rejected early.
acceptanceCriteria: State load path validates incoming persisted state against the frozen schema
Invalid or unsupported versions fail with structured validation errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement save-time schema validation boundary
userStories.description: As a developer, I want workflow state validated at save time so that only compliant state is persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: State save path validates state payload against the frozen schema before writing
Persist operation blocks writes when validation fails
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enforce deterministic stage transition guards
userStories.description: As a workflow operator, I need transition guards so that stage changes remain deterministic under the frozen schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Define allowed stage transition matrix tied to schema state fields
Reject invalid transitions with explicit machine-readable reason
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add compatibility tests for migration and validation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need compatibility tests so that schema evolution and migration behavior stay regression-safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests covering legacy-version state migration to current schema
Add tests for load/save rejection on invalid schema payloads
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
researchTopics: Existing test harness patterns for workflow state and adapter compatibility

userStories.title: Document migration-safe compatibility rules in code artifacts
userStories.description: As a team member, I need compatibility rules documented in code artifacts so that future changes preserve backward safety.
acceptanceCriteria: Document compatibility guarantees and version bump rules in maintained code artifacts
Document required validation boundaries for state load and state save paths
Typecheck passes
